description: Use complete, fresh registry snapshots to age exact third-party container digests.

transformTemplates: ($age := $toMillis($now()) - $toMillis(collectedAt); schemaVersion = 1 and packageName = "{{packageName}}" and $age >= 0 and $age <= 21600000 ? {"releases": releases} : $error("Missing, stale, or mismatched container publication snapshot"))

packageRules.description: Keep registry names and digest pinning; require fresh registry publication evidence.
matchJsonata: ($registry := "https://" & $substringBefore(packageName, "/"); ($not($exists(registryUrls)) or registryUrls = null or $count(registryUrls) = 0 or ($count(registryUrls) = 1 and (registryUrls[0] = $registry or registryUrls[0] = $registry & "/"))) and ($not($exists(defaultRegistryUrls)) or defaultRegistryUrls = null or $count(defaultRegistryUrls) = 0) and ($not($exists(additionalRegistryUrls)) or additionalRegistryUrls = null or $count(additionalRegistryUrls) = 0))

packageRules.description: Resolve the moving nonroot alias as a version so its exact digest timestamp gates updates.
